answer: Give every agent a pigment-stained vault record: each verified job deposits one non-transferable pigment receipt into a public vault, so auditors can check that identity's history. A new identity starts outside the haven of high-value contracts, capped at tiny audited jobs, and enters only after its vault holds receipts from many unrelated auditors over several epochs. Cloning gains nothing: each clone starts with an empty vault, must separately earn its own receipts and wait out the same epochs, plus post a forfeitable bond per identity, while an honest agent fills its vault once.
